items.summary: The two RITM-200 nuclear reactors have been installed on the nuclear-powered icebreaker Leningrad , which is under construction at the Baltic Shipyard.

items.title: Ur-Energy makes first shipment from Wyoming uranium project
items.summary: Ur-Energy has made the first shipment of uranium from its Shirley Basin uranium mine, marking the project's transition to full operations and making the company a multi-asset uranium producer.

items.title: Blue Ghost to carry nuclear power source to the Moon
items.summary: Firefly Aerospace and Zeno Power Systems have announced a commercial payload agreement that will see a radioisotope heating unit developed to withstand the frigid conditions of the lunar night taken on one of Firefly Aerospace's Blue Ghost missions to the moon, potentially as soon as 2028.

items.title: Russia plans to add 30 GW nuclear capacity, expand exports
items.summary: President Vladimir Putin has set out the goals for Russia's nuclear energy sector and said that new capacity, including small modular reactors, in the Urals, Siberia and the country's Far East will help the long-term development of these regions.
